title: Kuwait fends off Iranian attack as Trump says renewed Mideast hostilities will not last 'too long'
summary: Kuwait's military confronted hostile missile and drone attacks from Iran on Thursday. President Trump stated that renewed Mideast hostilities will not persist long, signaling U.S. engagement in regional tensions.
content: On Thursday, Kuwait's army said it was confronting hostile missile and drone attacks from Iran.

title: Stock futures are little changed after major averages snap three-day losing streaks: Live updates

title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century
summary: A special U.S. Mint edition $1 coin features Donald Trump, making him the first living U.S. president to appear on circulating currency in over a century. The coin bears his portrait alongside the motto "In God we trust."
content: The US Mint special edition is stamped with a portrait of Trump alongside the words "In God we trust".

title: South Korea's semiconductor exports just tripled year-over-year. Is it too much of a good thing?

content: If growth were to slow in the semiconductor sector, would the slowdown take the Korean economy with it?
